ai.purpose: Define the detection grammar used to identify, classify, and validate structural patterns across any domain. Introduces detection operators, signal pathways, coherence thresholds, and structural signatures. Serves as the analytical engine for all downstream books.
ai.summary: Book 3 introduces the detection grammar that allows AI systems to identify and classify structural patterns. It defines detection operators, coherence thresholds, and structural signatures. This book is the analytical core of the AI Edition, unlocking both Opacity & Revelation (Book 4) and TEL Expression & Representation (Book 5).

references: INV-SD-001: Detection Validity — detection operators must preserve all primitive identities defined in FFT and IS
INV-SD-002: Coherence Threshold — a structure is detectable only when its relational signature exceeds the declared coherence threshold
INV-SD-003: Signature Stability — structural signatures must remain stable under all valid inversion and transformation operators
INV-SD-004: Operator Closure — detection operators must remain closed under the canonical detection grammar
